title: Application type
select_intro: The application decides which models, datasets and results the device works with. An administrator can change it later in Settings.
desc_detect: Finds and counts objects, drawing a box around each one.
desc_classify: Tells which class the whole image belongs to.
desc_segment: Outlines each object with its exact shape.
waiting_body: This device has no application type yet. An administrator must choose one before it can be used.
unsupported_body: This device runs the '{{ task }}' application, which this interface does not support. An administrator can choose a supported application.
migrated_note: Set automatically when this device was upgraded.
confirm_body: The device will run {{ task }}. Detection stops, and the active model is deselected when it belongs to another application. Models, datasets and records are kept.
failed_to_change: Could not change the application type: {{ err }}
desc_face: Names the people it knows; their photos and the gallery stay on this device.
